title: EARLY $8,000 NEAR PELICAN VALLEY
yt_title: GTA 6 Easy $8,000 Early: Pelican Valley Safe Code 0072 and Door Code 0212
hook: Fast early cash in GTA 6: a hidden building near Pelican Valley holds $8,000 and a VF5 SMG, behind three codes.
tips: 1. Pelican Valley house: power switch, computer password (last carved word CLEAVES), safe code 0072, note with door code 0212 (clip audio 0:00-1:00, safe keypad display reads 0072)
2. Small building by the dock needs 0212: inside a VF5 SMG with flashlight and a bag with $8,000 (clip audio 0:42-1:00)
3. A mutated creature attacks when you turn around (clip audio 0:24)
desc_steps: 1. Open the map and go to the house in the middle, near Pelican Valley.
2. Inside, the power is out. Go round the back of the house and turn on the power switch.
3. Back inside, the computer is on but wants a password. In the adjacent room, words are carved into a wooden drawer. Enter the final word, CLEAVES, on the computer.
4. A massive mutated creature attacks when you turn around. Deal with it.
5. Next to the computer is a TitanVault safe. Enter 0072. Inside: $100 in cash and a note with the code 0212.
6. Leave the house and head toward the dock by the river. The small building there needs a code. Type 0212.
7. Inside, loot a VF5 SMG with a flashlight and a bag with $8,000 in cash.
script_display: Fast early cash in GTA 6. A hidden building near Pelican Valley holds eight thousand dollars, behind three codes. One. Go to the house in the middle, near Pelican Valley on the map. Two. The power is out. Go round the back and flip the power switch. Three. The computer needs a password: the last word carved in the wooden drawer next door, cleaves. Four. Survive the mutant, then open the safe by the computer: zero zero seven two. Five. Grab the note with the code zero two one two and take it to the small building by the dock. Six. Type it in. Inside, loot a VF5 SMG and a bag with eight thousand dollars. Got the eight thousand? Comment how long it took.
verify: Source: William's own @fluxx7x clip (src_clean.mp4, 60 s). Audio transcribed locally (faster-whisper small.en) and matched to frames: map destination near Pelican Valley (4-6 s), power out and power switch behind the house (8-12 s), computer password screen (15-16 s), carved drawer list with last word CLEAVES and red arrow (19-23 s), mutant attack (24-29 s), TitanVault safe keypad display reading 0072 (32-35 s; the clip's burned-in caption says 00072 but the keypad shows four digits), $100 in safe and note 'Emergency Go Protocol 02.12' (35-39 s), dock walk and small-building keypad typing 0212 (41-47 s), SMG with flashlight (55 s), bag $8,000 with LOOT prompt (57-59 s; amount from clip audio and caption). Skipped the body at 49-51 s (gore).
